CustomField.description: TRUE when cumulative active Quote MRC/NRC across the Account exceeds credit limits, or Account has overdue 90+ days. Triggers Credit Limit Finance Approval.
CustomField.formula: IF( ISBLANK(Opportunity.Account.Credit_Limit_MRC__c) && ISBLANK(Opportunity.Account.Credit_Limit_NRC__c) && Opportunity.Account.Overdue_90_Days__c = 0, FALSE, (NOT(ISBLANK(Opportunity.Account.Credit_Limit_MRC__c)) && Opportunity.Account.Total_Active_Quoted_MRC__c > Opportunity.Account.Credit_Limit_MRC__c) || (NOT(ISBLANK(Opportunity.Account.Credit_Limit_NRC__c)) && Opportunity.Account.Total_Active_Quoted_NRC__c > Opportunity.Account.Credit_Limit_NRC__c) || Opportunity.Account.Overdue_90_Days__c > 0 )
CustomField.inlineHelpText: TRUE when cumulative active quotes exceed the account credit limits (MRC or NRC), or the account has overdue balances beyond 90 days. Triggers Credit Limit Finance Approval.
CustomField.label: Credit Limit Exceeded
